guidance_decisions.name: go-api-contracts
guidance_decisions.reason: Only tests change; the exported API, supported behavior, and Go minimum stay unchanged.

guidance_decisions.name: go-core-style
guidance_decisions.reason: Writing Go tests benefits from idiomatic naming, explicit error handling, simple structure, formatting, and concurrency discipline.

guidance_decisions.name: go-interfaces-and-composition
guidance_decisions.reason: No interface, concrete dependency, constructor, options API, dependency wiring, or production resource lifecycle changes; fixture lifetime is test-owned.

guidance_decisions.name: go-package-boundaries
guidance_decisions.reason: No package creation, movement, responsibility, imports ownership, or import-direction changes.
